headline: Seed pinning reaches 35 titles
lede: Batch 5 of the #1473 rollout: the pure engines — Emberwood, ViperPit, CivilizationV, Myst — now carry a seed in every filed report and replay the same world from ?seed=N. PickRush's seed became visible to the law, and BardsTale reports honestly seedless.

notes.text: Emberwood, ViperPit, CivilizationV and Myst report {tick,score,done,seed} in production and honor ?seed=N — a filed bug replays the exact Vale, matchup or map. ViperPit pins offline only; online keeps the lobby seed (SSX desync rule).

PickRush has pinned seeds since #1472 but its report handed the scanner a function reference — the inline restructure makes its seed count in the feedbackcheck law. Rollout floor 24→35 with a proven mutant (strip a pin → RED).
BardsTale reports seedless {tick,score=gold,done,deepest}: its six dungeons are fixed floors by design, faithful to the original — there is no per-run seed to fake.

Two-slot collision handled cleanly: slot b's empty-squash #1478 incident happened while batch 5 was in flight; batch-4 classic ports merged as 96bec0d and batch 5 rebased onto it, resolving the floor line to 35 by merge order.
